paragraphs: Mentioned at the end of Jerusalem Talmud Maaserot: R' Menachem bar Maksima, brother of R' Yonatan Kippa.[^1]

notes.text: End-of-Maaserot remains unnumbered and not independently checked against a named edition. This notice has מכסימא/Maksima and קיפא; companion 31 has מבסימא/Mevasima and קיפה. Both supplied texts stay distinct. Menachem is the brother of Yonatan, not the reverse modifier; all three title occurrences here remain R'.
